## Summary

## Scope

- [ ] The change is limited to the issue or agreed task.
- [ ] Unrelated refactoring has not been included.
- [ ] I understand and can explain the complete change.

## Testing

List the exact commands run and their results:

```text
# command
# result
```

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] Authentication and authorization were reviewed.
- [ ] User, event, department, and owner scope were reviewed.
- [ ] Input mapping, CSRF, sessions/tokens, and data exposure were reviewed where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, production data, or personal records were included.
- [ ] Dependency, migration, and configuration changes were manually reviewed.
